title: DB default settings - Crash
body:
9 beta 4
The program crashes every time Im going Misc - DB default settings

comments.body: Looks like a regression. Need more investigation.

By the way (I seen it before):
It is strange to meet button 'Load default' on the page 'DB default settings'.
Finally found out the issue. Modified.
BTW. It is not strange to have load default in default settings. The effect is the same as discard button. This can save a lot of code.
